```python
import chrono as ch
import chrono.vehicle as veh
import chrono.sensor as sens

# 1. Initialize the PyChrono environment and core components
ch.set_default_G_acc(9.81)

# 2. Create the simulation
sim = ch.Simulation()

# 3. Initialize the vehicle
gator = veh.Gator(veh.VehicleType.Rigid)

# Set the initial position of the vehicle
gator.SetPos(ch.ChVector3d(0, 0, 1.1))

# Add vehicle to the simulation
sim.Add(gator)

# Set visualization types for various vehicle parts
gator.GetChassis().SetVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType.SHOW)
gator.GetWheels()[0].SetVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType.SHOW)
gator.GetWheels()[1].SetVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType.SHOW)
gator.GetWheels()[2].SetVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType.SHOW)
gator.GetWheels()[3].SetVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType.SHOW)

# 4. Create the terrain
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(sim.GetSystem())
terrain.SetGridSize(40, 40)
terrain.SetPlaneCoeffFriction(0.8)
terrain.SetPlaneCoeffRestitution(0.3)
terrain.Initialize()

# Add terrain to the simulation
sim.Add(terrain)

# 5. Create and initialize the interactive driver system
driver = veh.Driver(sim.GetSystem(), gator)
driver.SetSteeringType(veh.DriverSteeringType.KEYBOARD)
driver.SetDrivingType(veh.DriverDrivingType.KEYBOARD)
driver.Initialize()

# 6. Create a sensor manager
sensor_manager = sens.SensorManager(sim.GetSystem())

# Add point lights
light1 = sens.PointLight(ch.ChVector3d(0, 0, 10), ch.ChColor(1, 1, 1), 1000)
sensor_manager.AddSensor(light1)

light2 = sens.PointLight(ch.ChVector3d(10, 10, 10), ch.ChColor(1, 1, 1), 1000)
sensor_manager.AddSensor(light2)

# Add camera attached to the vehicle's chassis
camera = sens.Camera(ch.ChFrame3d(ch.ChVector3d(0, 0, 1), ch.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)), ch.ChVector3d(0, -10, 0))
camera.SetResolution(800, 600)
camera.SetFOV(60)
sensor_manager.AddSensor(camera)

# Create a callback for camera images
def camera_callback(time, image, frame):
    # Process the camera image here
    pass

# Set the callback for camera images
sensor_manager.SetCameraImageCallback(camera_callback)

# Simulation loop
while sim.GetSystem().GetChTime() < 10:
    # Update the driver
    driver.Update(0.02)

    # Update the terrain
    terrain.Update(0.02)

    # Update the vehicle
    gator.Update(0.02)

    # Update the sensor manager
    sensor_manager.Update(0.02)

    # Synchronize and advance the simulation modules
    sim.Step(0.02)

    # Render the camera images
    sensor_manager.Render()
```
